author: PlaysByBrulesRules
body:
I’ve never found anyone else voice this same opinion, but goblin fortresses are BUSTED in terms of XP and Orn gains for new T10 players.

First, put together an XP gear set. Godforge a Venin / Arisen Witch Staff. You need one for each hand, can be two Venins if you like. Mostly depends on your class and what mats you have. Put exp adornments in them. 

Try to acquire two Arisen Monster Tomes of as high quality as you can. They come from Arisen Fafnir. 

Get a mighty or Mightiest Mimic head, any quality, Godforge it. 

Now you have an EXP loadout. 

The simple way is to just do goblin fortresses with your gear on. Prioritize killing the T9 and T10 bosses, that’s what gives the most XP, everything else is scraps. 

If I recall correctly, I could get like ~1B xp from a single fortress without any buffs. 

Now, on a day where you have some time, do the following. Drive around and find 5-7 goblin fortresses. Enter them all but don’t finish them. 

Pop exp potion, super exp potion, Vulcan’s brew, shrine of wisdom, (do this during an exp event for more) + maybe other people know of more buffs

Then do all the goblin fortresses as fast as you can. Only kill T9/10 bosses and clear the floor as fast as you can, don’t worry about deepshards much. I can usually get about 7 cleared in an hour.

First time I did this I think I got 150B XP in an hour. I didn’t even have all the possible buffs stacked. 

There’s probably some from the astral tree you could use, or even proof of undying (I don’t recommend using that for this)
